name: services/photos/settings
description: Return all parameters with their values that regard photos configuration.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of following fields and their values:

  • max_photo_file_size - an integer, maximum size (in bytes) of photo file;

  • allow_to_upload_photo - a boolean value. This parameter indicates whether users are allowed to upload photo;

  • approve_photo_automatically - a boolean value. This parameter indicates whether photos uploaded by users will be approved automatically, without administrator review.

result_fields.name: max_photo_file_size
result_fields.description: an integer, maximum size (in bytes) of photo file

result_fields.name: allow_to_upload_photo
result_fields.description: a boolean value. This parameter indicates whether users are allowed to upload photo

result_fields.name: approve_photo_automatically
result_fields.description: a boolean value. This parameter indicates whether photos uploaded by users will be approved automatically, without administrator review
